name: Balance Type 13 Code
definition: Specifies the kind of the balance.

INVE.name: Investments
INVE.definition: Balance attributed to investments at value.

CASE.name: Cash And Cash Equivalents
CASE.definition: Balance attributed to cash and cash equivalents.

REVE.name: Revenues
REVE.definition: Balance attributed to revenues; including dividends, interest, net realised gains/losses etc.

IIOF.name: Investor Inflow Outflow
IIOF.definition: Balance attributed to investor inflow/outflow (creations, cancellations, income distributions).

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Balance attributed according to a different classification, which is not explictly defined.
